svg.aria-label: Propose, confirm, execute. 1: the workload (app or AI agent; untrusted, no credentials, no network; it reaches only the broker socket) proposes to the broker, which holds provider credentials. 2: the broker records a pending record at the gateway. 3: a person approves exact values, or a bounded mandate, on the gateway auth origin. 4: the gateway passes the approval to the authority (signing key, no network). 5: the authority sends a single-use signed grant to the broker. 6: the broker executes once at the provider (simulated in the demos).
